settings.hero_desc: A large (2x1 metre) master model of a starch factory facility - buildings, roads, tanks and landscaping laid out in detail on a presentation base. A commanding centrepiece for boardrooms, exhibitions and project reviews.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your facility, labels, branding and base
settings.s1_body: At two metres, this master model lays out an entire industrial facility - production buildings, offices, tanks, roads and landscaping - so engineers, clients and investors can read the whole site at a glance. Built from your plans, it's the centrepiece for boardrooms, exhibition stands and project reviews where a complex facility needs to be understood fast.
settings.case_body: Built for Oren Hydrocarbon to showcase their Starch Factory, this large master model impressed every visitor who came to the Oren Hydrocarbon factory. They loved the model so much that management commissioned 2 more factory models of their sites in Egypt and Iraq.
settings.case_quote: The scale of the model lets people grasp our whole facility instantly. A superb presentation tool.
settings.prov_p: A site plan is abstract; a large master model is real. Built to scale, it turns a complex facility into instant understanding and confidence.
